story: A user reports their monitor isn't working. The agent checks known issues (none found for monitors), runs performance diagnostics (detects hardware failure — display adapter failing), creates a ticket categorized as hardware, and escalates immediately to the infrastructure team per the ticket rules. This tests the hardware failure detection and mandatory escalation flow.

args.description: Monitor not receiving signal. Diagnostics indicate display adapter failure. Hardware replacement likely needed.

args.reason: Hardware failure detected — display adapter failing. Requires physical hardware replacement.
